Name: Improved and New Hairstyles
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
[size=3][b]Minor improvements to certain existing hairstyles for both male and females.
Also includes [s]12 [/s] 16 new hairstyles. [/b][/size]

[color=#e06666]Updated for SDV ver 1.4 and now compatible with CP.[/color] Special thanks to Alvadea for converting the mod!

Hairstyles were made more full and consistent with other views. Some of the original hairstyles are very flat and small in proportion to the head so I decided to make some edits. Hope you like them :)

Will add more edits in the future! Very soon.
[b]I do take requests and suggestions![/b] Also working on more NEW hairstyle ideas.

[b]Instructions for SMAPI and CP:[/b]
. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b]Instructions for .xnb mods:[/b]
. This mod replaces the original hairstyles.xnb. Please make a backup of the original file if necessary.
. Unzip or extract the [i]hairstyles.xnb[/i] file after downloading.
. Place the file into the Stardew Valley folder under [i]Content\Characters\Farmer[/i] and replace hairstyles.xnb.

[i]Due to the nature of hairstyles file, there will be several BALD hairstyles. This is normal![/i]
Thanks for downloading!
